subject.title: fix(ollama): preserve custom memory provider endpoints

question: Should this release intentionally invalidate and rebuild every existing Ollama memory index when endpoint-aware identity is restored?
rationale: Endpoint separation fixes a shipped regression, but the provider-key change creates observable upgrade work whose timing and acceptance belong to maintainers.

options.title: Narrow and prove before merge
options.body: Keep endpoint-aware keys, replace the global name heuristic with an explicit identity/credential contract, and provide real persisted-index upgrade proof.

options.title: Accept the current contract
options.body: Merge the broad sanitizer and one-time rebuild while explicitly accepting collisions for credential-named routing headers.

options.title: Limit the change to base URL
options.body: Remove header identity from this PR and restore only the previously shipped endpoint separation until a shared header contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Narrow and prove before merge
recommendation.body: Keep endpoint-aware keys, replace the global name heuristic with an explicit identity/credential contract, and provide real persisted-index upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior endpoint-aware Ollama memory implementation and substantial recent memory/provider work make this the strongest available routing candidate.
